sources.title: RolanDorisTech/Qwen3.8-9B-Distill-MLX-oQ5e · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-9B-Distill-oQ5e — 6.0GB MLX-native oQe MLX-native quantized version of Qwen3.8-9B-Distill, built with oMLX Universal Dynamic Quantization (oQe). Standard mlx-lm safetensors — works with mlx-lm, oMLX, LM Studio, and mlx-swift.

sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3.8: Qwen3.8 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the GitHub repository of the Qwen3.5 open model series, including Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and the latest Qwen3.8. Here, you can find official information about Qwen3.8, post your questions (Issues), and share your ideas with the community (Discussions).

sources.title: Empero — Independent AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: Empero is an independent AI research lab in Germany building small, efficient language models you can own and run yourself. Latest: Qwen3.8 distilled to 9B / 4B / 2B, and a GDN-aware 27B Ridge GGUF at 11.7 GiB. 1M+ downloads on Hugging Face.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-9B Distill by Empero: Benchmarks and Local Setup
sources.snippet: Empero distilled Qwen3.8's reasoning into a 9B dense model. Here's what the MMLU and GSM8K benchmarks show, and how to run it locally.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next upgrades the model systematically along four aspects — attention, residual, embedding and optimization — improving model capability while further optimizing computational efficiency, model capacity and training stability: Attention: A GDN + QSA hybrid architecture.
